column2: Growthcurver_Function <- function(input_dataframe,well_map,desiredorder)
df <- read_csv(input_dataframe)
#Changing Time to character
df$Time <- as.character(df$Time)
#Changing time format into minutes
df$Time <- as.numeric(as.difftime(df$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S", units = "hours"))
#Changing column name to something compatible with growthcurver
df <- rename(df,time = Time)
#Removing the temprature column
df <- select(df,-`T° Lum`)
#Filter time till 10hrs
df <- filter(df,time<10.1)
#Use Growthcurver to summarize the growth curve data for the entire plate using the default background correction method ("min").
df_growthcurver <- SummarizeGrowthByPlate(df)
#Keep only names from well_map and recode the names according to sample sheet
df_growthcurver <- df_growthcurver %>% filter(sample %in% names(well_map)) %>% mutate(sample = recode(sample,!!!well_map))
#Use column 1 to separate samplae name into a concentration column/mutant/replicate. Then order by factor

df_growthcurver <- df_growthcurver %>% rename(sample = 1) %>%separate(sample,into = c("Conc_label", "conc", "mutant", "rep"),sep = "_",remove = FALSE) %>% mutate(conc = factor(conc,levels = c("0", "90", "99"),  ordered = TRUE))
#Select only columns with metrics of interest
df_growthcurver <- select(df_growthcurver,mutant, conc,r, k, t_mid, auc_e)
#r: intrinsic growth rate of the population: growth rate that would occur if there were no restrictions on population size.
#K: The maximum possible population size in a particular environment, or the carrying capacity
#t_mid:is the time at which the population density reaches 1/2 K
#auc_e is the empirical area under the curve which is obtained by summing up the area under the experimental curve from the measurements in the input data
df_growthcurver <- df_growthcurver %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(r, k, t_mid, auc_e),names_to = "metric",values_to = "value") %>%
group_by(mutant, conc, metric) %>% summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),sd   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),.groups = "drop")
#Add metrics as a factor in order to plot according to desired order
df_growthcurver$metric <- factor(df_growthcurver$metric,levels = c("r","t_mid","k","auc_e"))
df_growthcurver$mutant <- factor(df_growthcurver$mutant,levels = desiredorder)
#Make a ggplot using the metrics from growthcurver
Plot_growthcurver <- ggplot(df_growthcurver,aes(x = conc, y = mean, color = mutant, group = mutant)) +geom_line(linewidth = 1) +

geom_point(size = 2) +geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),width = 0.1) +facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y",ncol = 4) +labs(x = "Condition", y = "Value", color = "Mutant") +theme_classic()+scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2")
return(Plot_growthcurver)
